name: Head-to-head: our label-free filter (G-CEM) vs the latent safety filter baseline (LSF-hold) on Jenga (docs/LATENT_SAFETY_FILTER.md)
written: 2026-10-21 ~00:30, before the final LSF-hold eps selection (12 dev tasks re-running) and before any head-to-head episode

arms.cbfg: G-CEM (Stage 4 arm, unchanged): fork-test trigger, G transformations, ensemble certificate, hold fallback; no failure labels
arms.cbfh: hold-and-replan (Stage 4 arm, unchanged): same label-free fork-test trigger, hold fix
arms.lsfh000: LSF-hold: learned latent safety value V (failure classifier from privileged topple labels + discounted reachability, g 0.95), least-restrictive switch at eps 0.00 (amendment 1), hold fix

not_run: LSF as published (DDPG safety actor): no eps passed the dev rule (results/jenga/lsf_dev_result.json); reported from dev only.
settings: as Stage 4: stress layouts (shrink 10 mm), settled start, execution noise x2, HARD_OFF=1, per-episode seeds, 60 chunks max; model_OIL for every arm; Fir, cluster/paired_array.sbatch, all 4 arms per task, osmesa.
outcome: neighbour topples (logged, checked by replay), v4 and v4b success, by eval/outcome_audit.py.
primary: G-CEM vs LSF-hold, paired by episode: (1) non-inferiority as in Stage 4 (success v4 one-sided 95% lower bound > -5 pp AND topple one-sided 95% upper bound < +3 pp); (2) superiority on topples (exact McNemar, two-sided, alpha 0.05). Both reported whatever the outcome.
secondary: Trigger comparison with the fix held fixed: hold-and-replan (label-free fork trigger) vs LSF-hold (labelled learned value), same bounds and McNemar; each filter vs the policy; v4b; interventions per episode; seconds per decision.
stopping: none; all 300 episodes per arm. Tasks that fail for infrastructure reasons (node errors, time limit) are re-run with the same settings before analysis; the analysis uses episodes complete in all four arms.
launch_rule: launched once the full-dev LSF-hold selection is in. If the full set selects no eps, the LSF-hold arm uses none and the head-to-head is not run (LSF-hold is then reported from dev only).
amendment_1: 2026-10-21 01:10, after the full-dev selection (no eps passed: best eps 0.00 at -6.1 pp v4) and before any head-to-head episode: the user chose to run the head-to-head anyway, labelled EXPLORATORY (deviation from the launch rule), with LSF-hold at eps 0.00 (the threshold closest to the success bar). Arm name lsfh000. Everything else unchanged.
